name: Senator
about: A stout senator from the Ricks Clip cast: a cream tunic under a purple toga, dark hair.
heightNote: the source skill gives no height: an everyday adult's

can.viewNotes: a card turned to the camera on yaw; three-quarter is the front with its head turned (romanFront's facing) and its body narrowed (ricks-cast.js)
can.faceNotes: STANDARD_FACES maps them to the cast's own (happy = grin, surprised = shock, worried = nervous, angry = stern; talk is the layer's; blink is a lid); all 18 of EXPRESSIONS by name too
can.poseNotes: the 14 arm poses (ARM_POSES) in L and R; sit is the layer's, on a stool, front, three-quarter or profile (sit: true)
can.hands: n/a: ink-dot hands, a finger on point
can.walk: walk with phase, in every view
can.talk: talkExpr(t): the open mouth and the closed one by turns; no lip sync
